narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I add two scoops of each, so the new ratio is six to eleven.
<bookmark mark='pale'/>The white grows by half, but the red grows by less than a quarter.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The shade changes, so adding the same number does not keep the ratio.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows 4 + 2 and 9 + 2 giving 6 : 11; a bowl that is too pale appears; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check each ratio, divide both terms by their highest common factor.
<bookmark mark='back'/>If you get four to nine back every time, your ratios are proportional.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer; two check lines appear: divide by the HCF; you should get 4 : 9 back

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu adds two to each term and gets six to eleven. Six to eleven is not four to nine in simplest form, so adding fails and the bubble is struck.
